source.title: Cancellation of WCA European Championship 2020
source.content:
With great regret, we have to announce the cancellation of [WCA European Championship 2020](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Euro2020) due to the COVID-19 outbreak. Due to the uncertain circumstance, the competition will not be rescheduled for a later date in this year. Competitors who are registered for this competition will be issued refunds over the next couple of weeks.

You will find more information on the WCA European Championship 2020 [Website](https://www.wcaeuro2020.nl/news/cancellation/).

We appreciate the community's kind understanding during this unsure time.

translation.title: 2020 年 WCA 欧洲锦标赛取消
translation.content:
我们很遗憾地宣布，受新冠疫情影响，[2020 年 WCA 欧洲锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Euro2020)取消。由于情况仍不明朗，比赛不会改期至今年晚些时候举行。已报名选手将在接下来几周收到退款。

更多信息请见 2020 年 WCA 欧洲锦标赛[官网](https://www.wcaeuro2020.nl/news/cancellation/)。

感谢社区在这段充满不确定性的时期给予理解。
